definitions.explanation: A bag filled with earth or sand, stacked to hold back floodwater or to build a temporary wall or barricade.

examples.japanese: {土嚢|どのう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{積|つ}む→積む：02294_tsumu⟧。

examples.english: We put sandbags in front of the entrance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}えて→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧、⟦{川沿|かわぞ}い→川沿い：03046_kawazoi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{土嚢|どのう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{並|なら}べた→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧。
examples.english: Residents along the river laid out sandbags to prepare for the typhoon.

notes:
Heard every rainy season and typhoon season, when towns hand out sandbags and residents stack them at doorways and along embankments.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {土嚢|どのう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{積|つ}む→積む：02294_tsumu⟧: to stack sandbags
- {土嚢袋|どのうぶくろ}: an (empty) sandbag
- ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧のう: a water bag used like a sandbag at home

WRITING:
- The character {嚢|のう} is rare, so the word is often written {土|ど}のう.
